detailed_description: The Calendar Heatmap Generator turns daily values into a calendar-style chart so you can spot streaks, gaps, and seasonal patterns quickly. It works well for contribution history, habit tracking, daily traffic, or any dataset organized by date. You can load date-and-value pairs, choose a color range, review the calendar preview, and export the result as PNG or SVG when you need a compact visual for dashboards, status updates, or documentation.
usage_steps: Enter or paste date-and-value rows in the editor so each day you care about is represented clearly.
Set the date range and chart title to match the period you want to review.
Choose colors that make low and high activity easy to distinguish in the calendar grid.
Inspect the preview to confirm missing days, busy periods, and labels look right.
Export the final calendar heatmap as PNG or SVG for sharing or embedding elsewhere.
usage_examples: Show daily product usage over a quarter to highlight busy periods and quiet weekends.
Track workout or study consistency over several months in a personal dashboard.
Visualize contribution activity for a project timeline or team update.
